title: DNS Phase 0 contracts, kinds, and config
intent: Freeze the foundational DNS domain contracts, kind allocations, and disabled-by-default configuration schema used by subsequent DNS work items.
scope: DNS domain enums, types, deterministic endpoint coordinates, and validators
Reserved DNS control-plane kind constants without reactor wiring
Nostr DNS read-model and reserved audit kind constants
DNS config defaults and validation gated by dns.enabled
out_of_scope: DNS backends, projectors, reconcilers, or app wiring
